component.name: ProbeScene
component.script: sub init() fonts = ["SmallestSystemFont", "SmallestBoldSystemFont", "SmallSystemFont", "SmallBoldSystemFont", "MediumSystemFont", "MediumBoldSystemFont", "LargeSystemFont", "LargeBoldSystemFont", "ExtraLargeSystemFont", "ExtraLargeBoldSystemFont"] texts = ["Roku Emulator fidelity probe", "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog", "0123456789", "WWWWW", "iiiii", "Ação é Útil"] y = 10 for each font in fonts x = 10 for each text in texts label = m.top.CreateChild("Label") label.id = font label.font = "font:" + font label.text = text label.translation = [x, y] label.color = "0xFFFFFFFF" x = x + 300 end for y = y + 105 end for end sub
